name: device-matrix-hud-shop
description: Regression matrix for the gameplay HUD and functional Hero Fist Shop at five landscape desktop, tablet, and phone resolutions.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='VQC Desktop 1920x1080' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1920,Height=1080,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({name=n,width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local names={'PowerValue','CoinsValue','DepthValue','ObjectiveText'} local fit=true for _,n in ipairs(names) do local x=h:FindFirstChild(n,true) fit=fit and x~=nil and x.TextFits end local p=h.ActionPunch local j=h.ActionJump return H:JSONEncode({fit=fit,punch=math.min(p.AbsoluteSize.X,p.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44,jump=math.min(j.AbsoluteSize.X,j.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44,menu=not g.GameMenu.Visible})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local h=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local inventory=h:FindFirstChild('InventoryButton') local shop=h:FindFirstChild('ShopButton') local punch=h:FindFirstChild('ActionPunch') local jump=h:FindFirstChild('ActionJump') local function overlaps(a,b) if not a or not b then return true end local ap,as,bp,bs=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize return ap.X<bp.X+bs.X and ap.X+as.X>bp.X and ap.Y<bp.Y+bs.Y and ap.Y+as.Y>bp.Y end local target=inventory and math.min(inventory.AbsoluteSize.X,inventory.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0 local centerDelta=inventory and shop and math.abs((inventory.AbsolutePosition.Y+inventory.AbsoluteSize.Y*.5)-(shop.AbsolutePosition.Y+shop.AbsoluteSize.Y*.5)) or 999 local gap=inventory and shop and shop.AbsolutePosition.X-(inventory.AbsolutePosition.X+inventory.AbsoluteSize.X) or -999 local beside=centerDelta<=16 and gap>=-1 and gap<=40 local clear=inventory and not overlaps(inventory,punch) and not overlaps(inventory,jump) local exact=inventory and inventory.Image=='rbxassetid://123409223461276' and inventory:GetAttribute('ToolAction')=='OpenInventory' return H:JSONEncode({ok=exact and target>=44 and beside and clear,target=target,beside=beside,clear=clear,centerDelta=centerDelta,gap=gap,image=inventory and inventory.Image,action=inventory and inventory:GetAttribute('ToolAction')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD
local viewport=safe.AbsoluteSize
assert(viewport.X>=280 and viewport.Y>=180,'rendered safe viewport unavailable or degenerate')
assert(math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportWidth') or 0)-viewport.X)<=1 and math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportHeight') or 0)-viewport.Y)<=1,'responsive viewport disagrees with rendered safe area')
-- BEGIN MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function inside(x,parent)
 local p,s,q,t=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize
 assert(s.X>0 and s.Y>0 and p.X>=q.X-1 and p.Y>=q.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y+1,'outside bounds: '..x.Name)
end
local function renderedFloor(x)
 local scale=1 local n=x
 while n do
  for _,child in ipairs(n:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('UIScale') then scale*=child.Scale end end
  n=n.Parent
 end
 local size=x.TextSize
 if x.TextScaled then local limit=x:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint') assert(limit,'unbounded scaled text: '..x.Name) size=limit.MinTextSize end
 return size*scale
end
local function readable(x,floor)
 assert(x and x.Visible and x.Text~='','missing readable text')
 assert(renderedFloor(x)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered text: '..x.Name)
 assert(x.TextFits==true,'text does not fit: '..x.Name)
 local b,s=x.TextBounds,x.AbsoluteSize
 assert(b.X>0 and b.Y>0 and b.X<=s.X+1 and b.Y<=s.Y+1,'rendered text bounds overflow: '..x.Name)
end
local function touch(x,floor)
 assert(math.min(x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered target: '..x.Name)
end
-- END MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function shown(x)
 local n=x
 while n and n~=g do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end
 return true
end

-- Device resolution is checked in Edit; the rendered safe area excludes device insets.
a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') task.wait(.4)

local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop
inside(g.GameMenu,safe) inside(s,g.GameMenu)
local notFitNames={} local small,notFit,cards=0,0,0
for _,d in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
 if d:IsA('GuiButton') and shown(d) then touch(d,44) end
 if (d:IsA('TextLabel') or d:IsA('TextButton')) and shown(d) and d.Text~='' and not d.TextFits then notFit+=1 table.insert(notFitNames,d.Name) end
 if d:IsA('Frame') and d.Name:sub(-8)=='ShopCard' then cards+=1 end
end
local scroll=s.ShopCatalogScroll inside(scroll,s)
local maxY=math.max(0,scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
assert(maxY>0,'desktop catalog must scroll') scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,maxY) task.wait(.2)
local result={visible=s.Visible,small=small,notFit=notFit,notFitNames=notFitNames,cards=cards,gap=true,viewportWidth=viewport.X,viewportHeight=viewport.Y,scrollY=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y}
assert(result.visible and result.small==0 and result.notFit==0 and result.cards==16,'Shop fit contract failed '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)

local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop
inside(g.GameMenu,safe) inside(s,g.GameMenu)
local scroll=s:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll')
assert(scroll and scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44,'catalog viewport cannot show a touch row')
inside(scroll,s)
local cards={} local primaryCount=0
for _,card in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
 if card:IsA('Frame') and card.Name:sub(-8)=='ShopCard' then
  table.insert(cards,card)
  assert(card.AbsoluteSize.Y>=104 and card.AbsoluteSize.Y<=112.5,'shop row height')
  local action=card:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('TextButton')
  assert(action,'shop action missing') touch(action,48) inside(action,card)
  for _,x in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
   if x:GetAttribute('ReadableTextRole')=='Primary' and x.Visible then readable(x,14) inside(x,card) primaryCount+=1 end
  end
  local rarity=card:FindFirstChild('Rarity') readable(rarity,12) inside(rarity,card)
 end
end
assert(#cards>0 and primaryCount>=#cards*4,'missing readable catalog fields')
for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA('GuiButton') and shown(x) then touch(x,44) end end
assert(s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='MobileReadableRowsV1' and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogColumns')==1,'compact Shop must use one readable column')
table.sort(cards,function(x,y) return x.AbsolutePosition.Y<y.AbsolutePosition.Y end)
local first,last=cards[1],cards[#cards]
local maxY=math.max(0,scroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
assert(maxY>0,'catalog fixture must scroll')
scroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,maxY)
task.wait(.15)
assert(math.abs(scroll.CanvasPosition.Y-maxY)<=1 and last.AbsolutePosition.Y<scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y and last.AbsolutePosition.Y+last.AbsoluteSize.Y<=scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y+1,'catalog cannot reach final row')
local saved=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
task.wait(1.2)
assert(s:FindFirstChild('ShopCatalogScroll')==scroll and first.Parent==scroll and math.abs(scroll.CanvasPosition.Y-saved)<=1,'idle catalog rebuilt or reset scroll')
local result={visible=s.Visible,small=0,notFit=0,cards=#cards,primary=primaryCount,layout=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout'),viewportWidth=viewport.X,viewportHeight=viewport.Y,scrollY=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y}

result.notFitNames={} result.gap=true assert(result.visible and result.cards==16,'Shop fit contract failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

local viewport=safe.AbsoluteSize
assert(viewport.X>=280 and viewport.Y>=180,'rendered safe viewport unavailable or degenerate')
assert(math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportWidth') or 0)-viewport.X)<=1 and math.abs((g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportHeight') or 0)-viewport.Y)<=1,'responsive viewport disagrees with rendered safe area')
-- BEGIN MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function inside(x,parent)
 local p,s,q,t=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize
 assert(s.X>0 and s.Y>0 and p.X>=q.X-1 and p.Y>=q.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=q.X+t.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=q.Y+t.Y+1,'outside bounds: '..x.Name)
end
local function renderedFloor(x)
 local scale=1 local n=x
 while n do
  for _,child in ipairs(n:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('UIScale') then scale*=child.Scale end end
  n=n.Parent
 end
 local size=x.TextSize
 if x.TextScaled then local limit=x:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint') assert(limit,'unbounded scaled text: '..x.Name) size=limit.MinTextSize end
 return size*scale
end
local function readable(x,floor)
 assert(x and x.Visible and x.Text~='','missing readable text')
 assert(renderedFloor(x)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered text: '..x.Name)
 assert(x.TextFits==true,'text does not fit: '..x.Name)
 local b,s=x.TextBounds,x.AbsoluteSize
 assert(b.X>0 and b.Y>0 and b.X<=s.X+1 and b.Y<=s.Y+1,'rendered text bounds overflow: '..x.Name)
end
local function touch(x,floor)
 assert(math.min(x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=floor-0.01,'small rendered target: '..x.Name)
end
-- END MEASURED MOBILE ASSERTIONS
local function shown(x)
 local n=x
 while n and n~=g do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end
 return true
end
